Tuesday Classic

Coeur d'Alene, ID · East Sherman · Road

Tuesday Classic is a road group ride in Coeur d'Alene, ID. It rolls every Tuesday at 5:30 pm from Workhorse office. Pace: ~18 mph.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 5:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 18 mph: brisk — you'll want some fitness.
Check
Look at @cdacyclingclub the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Tuesday Classic group ride

Weeknight road ride from the Workhorse office on East Sherman. Around 18 mph. The club also runs a Thursday flats ride, a Friday morning coffee ride and a Saturday noon ride from the same spot. Anyone can ride after signing the club's safety waiver.
